notes: Swarmstein (SWARMSTEIN): plain fixed-supply ERC-20 on Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663). 1,000,000,000 tokens (1e27 minor units, 18 decimals) are minted once to the deployer (the ProjectFactory) in a no-argument constructor; there is no mint, owner, admin, pause, blacklist, fee, tax, limit, proxy, delegatecall or selfdestruct. The factory distributes the supply: 10% to the launch's MerkleDistributor, 90% (poolBps) seeds the single-sided Uniswap v4 pool against IMD via the PoolManager 0x8366a39cc670b4001a1121b8f6a443a643e40951 at the 1.25% launch fee and tick spacing 60, and any remainder goes to remainderTo (the dead address). pool.initialPrice is provenance only: the deployer derives the opening sqrtPriceX96 from initialMarketCapWei (2500 IMD), the supply and the deployed currency order.
